about: Renders a quotation as its own block: a `figure` with an icon, the quotation and a caption.
author: Priya Raman, Head of Finance at Northwind

justify.about: The three alignments in a 512px room. At `start` the icon hangs in a start gutter, and at `center` and `end` it sits above the quotation.
justify.title: Alignment

motion.about: The animation a quotation enters with. Each one runs once when the quotation mounts.
motion.title: Motion

palette.about: Every palette in the surface look: the fill in `colorPalette.subtle`, the rule and the icon in `colorPalette.solid`.
palette.title: Palettes

quotation: Moving billing to one ledger cut our month-end close from nine days to two.

size.about: The five sizes. Each sets the body text style, the gaps and the start padding, and the icon is one line of the quotation tall.
size.title: Sizes

title: Blockquote

variant.about: `subtle` and `solid` render a rule down the start edge. `surface` adds a fill and rounds the end corners. `glass` renders the theme's glass surface. `plain` renders no rule.
variant.title: Looks
